experimental_design.evidence: inferred: Nude mice were randomly divided into 4 groups: (a) no UVB exposure (control); (b) UVB irradiation alone (UVB + PBS); (c) UVB irradiation with AMSC-EV (UVB + A-EV) and (d) UVB irradiation with HUMSC-EV (UVB + HU-EV).

factor_value.evidence: inferred: AMSC-EV or HUMSC-EV were subcutaneously injected into 10 different sites evenly on the whole dorsal skin using a BD insulin syringe (Ultra-Fine).
